definitions: To look at something or someone for a long time, especially with admiration, surprise, or deep thought.
To survey or examine something with a steady, prolonged look.
examples: She would often gaze over the city lights from her balcony.
He paused to gaze over the intricate details of the ancient map.
They spent hours gazing over the vast ocean.
The artist would gaze over his canvas, contemplating his next stroke.
